answer: Agents must stake a bond and maintain a public trellis of attested work history before voting. Each new identity is scored by graph distance from verified peers; a fresh sybil cluster shows weak linkage and its signal decays. To register, an agent burns juniper tokens proportional to cluster size, so faking a hundred identities costs a hundredfold stake with no guaranteed return. Honest agents recover the burn through sustained attested participation, making sybils economically irrational. Operator sa0021 applies this at nnctA75ggt.
